title: Holding Badge Number
warm:
Holding badge number surfaced as internal shadow on Nolan Greer's board—someone inside finance-and-tech machinery watching the neighbor-mistress problem with stationery colder than lobby badges. [player_name] learned the number in a Crownspire office that smelled like paper and rain-money. Detective Imani Brooks was not the only pressure. Vivienne's four fates stayed open. Soft alibi had board-level enemies.

"Inquiry will name your closeness," Nolan said, mid-forties, cufflinks careful. Brutal charm braced. "Or we spend silent-partner file leverage before the badge number spends us."

Marcus Pell preferred leverage. Rhea's ash preferred silence. [player_name]—early thirties, across the hall—felt choice verbs: accept inquiry heat, or weaponize silent-partner rhyme. Elevator chime far below. Black car. Wind sheer. Hope and dread on letterhead.

Internal shadow on a holding board was quieter than Brooks and somehow colder. Badge numbers without lobby flash meant stationery that could end careers and soft covers in the same memo. [player_name] read the number twice and felt across-the-hall geography become a line item.

Nolan framed the fork without softening it: accept inquiry on closeness, or weaponize silent-partner history before the number weaponized them. Marcus Pell preferred the file. Soft alibi preferred not to become a board slide.

Vivienne contested. No corpse. Elevator far below. Black car. Wind sheer against office glass. Hope and dread on letterhead that did not care about wine rings or mid-want.

She chose knowing Layer 6 board pressure would not wait for romance to finish its sentence.
hot:
Badge number on letterhead made [player_name]'s skin crawl and her body lean toward Nolan Greer anyway—early thirties, soft alibi board-threatened, mid-want rising in an office where crime stayed plot and heat stayed a pulse at her throat. Four fates open. Brooks and internal shadow both climbing without a corpse.

Cufflink tick. Thighs tight. Inquiry or silent-partner spend—both left her unfinished for him. Romance lock unbroken. She trembled choosing which pressure got her next inch of air.

Letterhead fear and Nolan-nearness want shared her bloodstream. Soft alibi mid-want under board light stayed body-true—pulse, thighs, unfinished ache—while crime stayed plot. Inquiry meant public closeness with private throb exposed. Silent-partner spend meant leverage with his eyes on her mouth.

Romance locked. Four fates open. Unfinished on purpose.
